Spiritual leaders advise time management and self‑reflection

Two Indian media outlets reported that a spiritual teacher offered personal‑development advice. One outlet identified the teacher as Sadhguru and urged readers to spend a minute each day to pinpoint at least one aspect of life that needs improvement. The other outlet named Swami Awdheshanand Giri and emphasized practical time‑management tips, recommending a fixed schedule for meals, sleep, study and other daily tasks to achieve a disciplined and organized life. Both pieces present the guidance as a way to improve personal discipline and success. No government or legal action is involved, and the advice is presented as a voluntary life lesson.
